title: HumanApprovalLogEntry
description: A record of a human approval event, capturing what was approved or rejected and the context.

approval_id.description: Unique identifier for this approval record.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the approval decision.

requested_by_agent.description: Agent ID that requested this approval.

sprint_context.description: Sprint number during which this approval was requested.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is being approved.

linked_decision_id.description: DEC-NNNN identifier of the associated decision, if any.

linked_henka_id.description: HK-NNNN identifier of the associated henkaten record, if any.

position_paper_path.description: Path to the nemawashi position paper (for nemawashi-major approvals).

revision_notes.description: Notes from the user explaining any requested revisions.

effective_autonomy_at_request.description: Effective autonomy level at the time the approval was requested.
